version.approval_notes:
This is a Manifest V3 sidebar extension. The JavaScript is bundled by esbuild and code-split so that no file is over 5 MB: panel.js is the app (Preact, the PDF reader pdfjs-dist, ExcelJS), chunk-*.js is the Actual API, loaded when the user connects (about 4.8 MB because the SQLite WebAssembly it uses is inlined as base64), and pdf.worker.js is the PDF.js worker. There is no remote code and no eval.

The "Function constructor is eval" warnings in the add-on check come from bundled libraries (global-object lookups in PDF.js and others). The content security policy has no unsafe-eval, so that code cannot run as eval.

Build from the attached source (Node 22.14 or newer, tested with 24):
    npm ci
    node scripts/build-extension.mjs --firefox
The output is in dist-extension-firefox/.

Convert tests need no server: open the sidebar, choose fixtures/hdfc-sample.csv (made-up data). Expect 6 transactions, a passed balance check and payee names such as Swiggy and Zomato.

Pushing needs an Actual server (https://actualbudget.org/docs/install/). The extension asks for optional access to the server's origin when connecting. It reads only the active Actual tab's address.

Permissions: localhost and 127.0.0.1 so the panel can find the Actual tab and connect to a local server; optional https://*/* requested at runtime for the one server the user types.
